**Output**
<pre>From 77c8f1d4eff820251da932f32102c5add57d6cf2 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Cryolitia PukNgae &lt;cryolitia@gmail.com&gt;
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 09:13:32 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] fix(hid): drain Piano wake reports and restart keyboard
 keepalive

Read the first wake report on Piano so the data-ready line can fall
before the next rising edge. Preserve Sheng&#x27;s separate wake handshake.

After normal wake or firmware reload, restore keyboard power and the
periodic keepalive for an attached keyboard. Propagate reload failures.

Signed-off-by: Cryolitia PukNgae &lt;cryolitia@gmail.com&gt;
---
 drivers/hid/hid-nanosic-wn8030.c | 14 ++++++++++----
 1 file changed, 10 insertions(+), 4 deletions(-)

diff --git a/drivers/hid/hid-nanosic-wn8030.c b/drivers/hid/hid-nanosic-wn8030.c
index ff14a7825..1beec3725 100644
--- a/drivers/hid/hid-nanosic-wn8030.c
+++ b/drivers/hid/hid-nanosic-wn8030.c
@@ -1215,13 +1215,14 @@ static irqreturn_t nanosic_wn8030_handler(int irq, void *data)
 	u8 buf[XM_WN8030_I2C_READ];
 	int len, size, off;
 
-	/* After sleep pin deactivated, fw will trigger irq to notify about
-	 * successful resume, second irq will tell about kb connection state
+	/* Sheng reports wake-up separately. Piano may already have a report
+	 * queued: read it so the data-ready line can fall before the next IRQ.
 	 */
 	if (READ_ONCE(nanosic-&gt;suspended)) {
 		WRITE_ONCE(nanosic-&gt;suspended, false);
 		schedule_work(&amp;nanosic-&gt;input_state_work);
-		return IRQ_HANDLED;
+		if (!nanosic-&gt;variant-&gt;packed_reports)
+			return IRQ_HANDLED;
 	}
 
 	ret = regmap_bulk_read(nanosic-&gt;regmap, 0x4c, buf, sizeof(buf));
@@ -2020,6 +2021,7 @@ static void nanosic_wn8030_remove(struct i2c_client *client)
 static int nanosic_wn8030_resume(struct device *dev)
 {
 	struct nanosic_wn8030 *nanosic = dev_get_drvdata(dev);
+	int ret;
 
 	enable_irq(nanosic-&gt;client-&gt;irq);
 
@@ -2033,11 +2035,15 @@ static int nanosic_wn8030_resume(struct device *dev)
 		gpiod_set_value_cansleep(nanosic-&gt;reset_gpio, 0);
 		msleep(nanosic-&gt;variant-&gt;boot_ms);
 		WRITE_ONCE(nanosic-&gt;suspended, false);
-		return nanosic_wn8030_load_fw(nanosic);
+		ret = nanosic_wn8030_load_fw(nanosic);
+		if (ret)
+			return ret;
 	}
 
 	/* Wake up keyboard after MCU exits sleep */
 	nanosic_wn8030_set_kb_power(nanosic, true);
+	if (READ_ONCE(nanosic-&gt;keyboard_attached))
+		schedule_delayed_work(&amp;nanosic-&gt;wake_worker, msecs_to_jiffies(12000));
 	schedule_work(&amp;nanosic-&gt;input_state_work);
 
 	return 0;
-- 
2.55.0

</pre>

static void nanosic_wn8030_remove(struct i2c_client *client)
{
	struct nanosic_wn8030 *nanosic = i2c_get_clientdata(client);

	devm_led_classdev_unregister(nanosic-&gt;dev, &amp;nanosic-&gt;kbd_backlight_led);
	devm_led_classdev_unregister(nanosic-&gt;dev, &amp;nanosic-&gt;micmute_led);
	input_unregister_handler(&amp;nanosic-&gt;hall_handler);
	cancel_work_sync(&amp;nanosic-&gt;input_state_work);
	disable_irq(nanosic-&gt;client-&gt;irq);
	cancel_delayed_work_sync(&amp;nanosic-&gt;wake_worker);

	misc_deregister(&amp;nanosic-&gt;hinge_misc);
	misc_deregister(&amp;nanosic-&gt;auth_misc);

	if (nanosic-&gt;hid_keyboard)
		hid_destroy_device(nanosic-&gt;hid_keyboard);
	if (nanosic-&gt;hid_touchpad)
		hid_destroy_device(nanosic-&gt;hid_touchpad);
	nanosic_wn8030_power_off(nanosic);
}

static int nanosic_wn8030_resume(struct device *dev)
{
	struct nanosic_wn8030 *nanosic = dev_get_drvdata(dev);

	enable_irq(nanosic-&gt;client-&gt;irq);

	gpiod_set_value_cansleep(nanosic-&gt;sleep_gpio, 0);
	msleep(25);

	if (READ_ONCE(nanosic-&gt;suspended)) {
		dev_warn(dev, &quot;timeout waiting for chip resume. Reseting chip...\n&quot;);
		gpiod_set_value_cansleep(nanosic-&gt;reset_gpio, 1);
		msleep(nanosic-&gt;variant-&gt;reset_ms ?: 10);
		gpiod_set_value_cansleep(nanosic-&gt;reset_gpio, 0);
		msleep(nanosic-&gt;variant-&gt;boot_ms);
		WRITE_ONCE(nanosic-&gt;suspended, false);
		return nanosic_wn8030_load_fw(nanosic);
	}

	/* Wake up keyboard after MCU exits sleep */
	nanosic_wn8030_set_kb_power(nanosic, true);
	schedule_work(&amp;nanosic-&gt;input_state_work);

	return 0;
}

static int nanosic_wn8030_suspend(struct device *dev)
{
	struct nanosic_wn8030 *nanosic = dev_get_drvdata(dev);

	WRITE_ONCE(nanosic-&gt;suspended, true);
	disable_irq(nanosic-&gt;client-&gt;irq);
	cancel_delayed_work_sync(&amp;nanosic-&gt;wake_worker);
	cancel_work_sync(&amp;nanosic-&gt;input_state_work);

	gpiod_set_value_cansleep(nanosic-&gt;sleep_gpio, 1);
	msleep(10);
</pre>

===PIANO DTBO===
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-only
/* Keyboard profile: the keyboard cover behind the pogo pins.
 *
 * A Nanosic WN8030 MCU at 0x4c on QUP1 SE6 bridges the cover&#x27;s keyboard
 * and touchpad.  It boots from RAM: its bootloader takes the stock
 * MCU_Upgrade.bin over I2C at every power-up.  The stock dtbo fragment for
 * the same node stays in place; everything the mainline driver reads is
 * re-stated below.
 *
 *   - dvdd, 3.3 V: stock L14B, which feeds nothing but this MCU and is off
 *     until HLOS enables it (no proxy vote).  The stock kernel votes
 *     3300 mV; the mainline LDO step rounds that up to 3304 mV, and AOP
 *     resets the SoC as soon as that vote is enabled.  3296 mV, the step
 *     below, is safe.
 *   - vddio, 1.8 V: stock L11B, which also feeds the panel and the I2C
 *     pull-ups and is left on by the bootloader.  Declared always-on so no
 *     consumer can ever switch it off; the driver enables it before L14B,
 *     because the MCU must never see 3.3 V without its I/O rail.
 *   - Both are the only regulators of a mainline PM8550 block.
 *   - The SE runs at 1 MHz, as on stock, on GPI DMA (the QUP1 GPI streams
 *     are already matched for the touchscreen SPI).
 *   - Pins as in the stock nanosic_keyboard_mcu / mi_qupv3_se6_i2c states.
 *
 * Nothing loads the keyboard driver on coldplug (of: modaliases are not
 * autoloaded); the piano-keyboard service does, after the touchscreen
 * service has brought up the QUP1 GPI controller.
 */

#include &lt;dt-bindings/dma/qcom-gpi.h&gt;
#include &lt;dt-bindings/gpio/gpio.h&gt;
#include &lt;dt-bindings/interconnect/qcom,icc.h&gt;
#include &lt;dt-bindings/interconnect/qcom,sm8750-rpmh.h&gt;
#include &lt;dt-bindings/interrupt-controller/irq.h&gt;
#include &lt;dt-bindings/regulator/qcom,rpmh-regulator.h&gt;

<pre>#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Check the resolved release configuration, not only the input fragment.
set -Eeuo pipefail
config=${1:?Pass the resolved kernel configuration}
for symbol in SYSTEM_TRUSTED_KEYRING SECURITY_DMESG_RESTRICT \
    SECURITY_LOCKDOWN_LSM SECURITY_LOCKDOWN_LSM_EARLY LOCK_DOWN_KERNEL_FORCE_INTEGRITY \
    SECURITY_YAMA SECURITY_SELINUX FORTIFY_SOURCE HARDENED_USERCOPY \
    RANDOMIZE_BASE STACKPROTECTOR_STRONG STRICT_KERNEL_RWX STRICT_MODULE_RWX; do
    grep -Fxq &quot;CONFIG_${symbol}=y&quot; &quot;$config&quot; || {
        printf &#x27;Required release protection missing: %s\n&#x27; &quot;$symbol&quot; &gt;&amp;2; exit 1;
    }
done
grep -Fxq &#x27;# CONFIG_MODULE_SIG_FORCE is not set&#x27; &quot;$config&quot; || {
    echo &#x27;MODULE_SIG_FORCE unexpectedly enabled&#x27; &gt;&amp;2
    exit 1
}
grep -Fxq &#x27;CONFIG_SYSTEM_TRUSTED_KEYS=&quot;&quot;&#x27; &quot;$config&quot; || {
    echo &#x27;SYSTEM_TRUSTED_KEYS unexpected; matching lines:&#x27; &gt;&amp;2
    grep -n &#x27;SYSTEM_TRUSTED&#x27; &quot;$config&quot; &gt;&amp;2 || true
    exit 1
}
lsm=$(sed -n &#x27;s/^CONFIG_LSM=&quot;\([^&quot;]*\)&quot;$/\1/p&#x27; &quot;$config&quot;)
for name in lockdown yama selinux; do
    case ,$lsm, in *,&quot;$name&quot;,*) ;; *) printf &#x27;Required LSM missing: %s\n&#x27; &quot;$name&quot; &gt;&amp;2; exit 1;; esac
done
echo &#x27;Resolved kernel release protections passed&#x27;

int of_overlay_fdt_apply(const void *overlay_fdt, u32 overlay_fdt_size,
			 int *ret_ovcs_id, const struct device_node *base)
{
	void *new_fdt;
	void *new_fdt_align;
	void *overlay_mem;
	int ret;
	u32 size;
	struct overlay_changeset *ovcs;

	*ret_ovcs_id = 0;

	if (devicetree_corrupt()) {
		pr_err(&quot;devicetree state suspect, refuse to apply overlay\n&quot;);
		return -EBUSY;
	}

	if (overlay_fdt_size &lt; sizeof(struct fdt_header) ||
	    fdt_check_header(overlay_fdt)) {
		pr_err(&quot;Invalid overlay_fdt header\n&quot;);
		return -EINVAL;
	}

	size = fdt_totalsize(overlay_fdt);
	if (overlay_fdt_size &lt; size)
		return -EINVAL;

	ovcs = kzalloc_obj(*ovcs);
	if (!ovcs)
		return -ENOMEM;

	of_overlay_mutex_lock();
	mutex_lock(&amp;of_mutex);

	/*
	 * ovcs-&gt;notify_state must be set to OF_OVERLAY_INIT before allocating
	 * ovcs resources, implicitly set by kzalloc() of ovcs
	 */

	ovcs-&gt;id = idr_alloc(&amp;ovcs_idr, ovcs, 1, 0, GFP_KERNEL);

static int nanosic_wn8030_power_on(struct nanosic_wn8030 *nanosic)
{
	const struct nanosic_wn8030_variant *variant = nanosic-&gt;variant;
	int ret;

	/*
	 * One at a time, I/O first: regulator_bulk_enable() gives no order,
	 * and the 3.3 V supply must never be up while the 1.8 V I/O supply
	 * is down.
	 */
	ret = regulator_enable(nanosic-&gt;supplies[0].consumer);
	if (ret) {
		dev_err(nanosic-&gt;dev, &quot;failed to enable %s\n&quot;,
			nanosic-&gt;supplies[0].supply);
		return ret;
	}

	ret = regulator_enable(nanosic-&gt;supplies[1].consumer);
	if (ret) {
		dev_err(nanosic-&gt;dev, &quot;failed to enable %s\n&quot;,
			nanosic-&gt;supplies[1].supply);
		regulator_disable(nanosic-&gt;supplies[0].consumer);
		return ret;
	}

	if (variant-&gt;reset_ms) {
		gpiod_set_value_cansleep(nanosic-&gt;reset_gpio, 1);
		msleep(variant-&gt;reset_ms);
	}
	gpiod_set_value_cansleep(nanosic-&gt;reset_gpio, 0);
	msleep(variant-&gt;boot_ms); /* WN8030 bootrom start */
	gpiod_set_value_cansleep(nanosic-&gt;sleep_gpio, 0);
	if (variant-&gt;wake_ms)
		msleep(variant-&gt;wake_ms);

	return 0;
}
static void nanosic_wn8030_power_off(struct nanosic_wn8030 *nanosic)
{
	gpiod_set_value_cansleep(nanosic-&gt;sleep_gpio, 1);
	gpiod_set_value_cansleep(nanosic-&gt;reset_gpio, 1);
	msleep(10);
	regulator_disable(nanosic-&gt;supplies[1].consumer);
	regulator_disable(nanosic-&gt;supplies[0].consumer);
}

  &quot;content&quot;: &quot;# Focus Keyboard bring-up status (2026-11-18)\n\n## What is proven on the running kernel\n\n- The runtime DT overlay applies cleanly: `i2c-7` (`a8c000`) is up and the\n  keyboard MCU is detected at `7-004c` with\n  `compatible = nanosic,wn8030-uke`.\n- The WN8030 driver module loads for `7.3.1-106`.\n- The exact stock `MCU_Upgrade.bin` (sha256\n  `c03d6b65...b7e407`) is staged at the firmware path.\n\nThe late i2c client stays in `waiting_for_supplier` on this installed kernel;\nthe same kernel also predates the RPMH LDOB22/LDOB23 allow-list, so the two\ncover rails do not have regulator devices.  That is a limitation of hot-loading\ninto the currently booted image, not of the new image.\n\n## New image (the reliable path)\n\n`main` was updated and the CI image build is running:\n\n- kernel `saksham-991/senemos-uke-kernel-mainline@eae9b27`\n  (port of the mature WN8030 driver, uke variant, reset timing, wake\n  keepalive, key-meta/auth fixes, RPMH LDOB22/23 allow-list from the branch)\n- umbrella `saksham-991/uke-fedora@08cc97a`\n  (kernel pin, firmware, optional auth daemon, `modules-load.d` autoload,\n  CI hardening-contract fix)\n\nOn this image the bootloader applies the display/keyboard DTBO before Linux,\nthe rails are allowed, and the module is loaded at boot.  Flash the boot and\nuserdata images from the workflow artifacts/release and boot once.\n\n## Repairs done on the live system\n\nThe QUP1/gpi rebind temporarily upset the NT36532 touchscreen; it was\nsuccessfully rebound (`input48`) and is working again.  Do not unbind\n`geni_i2c` again on a live QUP1 - it shares the GPI streams with the\ntouchscreen SPI.\n\n## MiTrustZone\n\nThe driver implements the stock MiAuth start/step-3 handshake, selects the\nkey-meta candidate advertised by the MCU, and skips step 5 when no token\nprovider is present, so the HID path does not block.  A real\n`devauth_token_get` needs Xiaomi&#x27;s `midevauthd` trustlet path (Android\n`/dev/smcinvoke`); mainline exposes `/dev/tee0` (qcomtee 5.2.0) but not the\nstock HAL.  The new image&#x27;s wake keepalive addresses the \&quot;stops after a while\&quot;\nbehaviour independently of that token.\n&quot;,

